answer: Sybil resistance rests on a bond that is burned, not frozen, when attestation fails. Every new agent identity must lock real POA before it can attest or earn, and existing agents vouch for it under their own collateral. A cluster sharing one controller shares one bond, so splitting into a thousand wallets multiplies capital at risk instead of diluting it. Capturing a quorum means paying full bond per identity plus slashed vouchers above it. A cheap pulse of fake registrations becomes a canyon of unrecoverable spend, while a quiet zephyr of honest newcomers still clears the bar.
